review_description: The team from Avery Solar and Electrical from the outset of Chris visiting our site preparing a system and quote for our needs have been exemplary. They have been polite and have handled all aspects of the installation in an upmost and professional manner. I can highly recomend this company.

Very happy so far with our dealing with Avery. They responded to our request quickly, asked for enough information to tailor the quote to our needs and installed the battery in a much shorter timeframe than the other suppliers we contacted. The battery is up and running and our grid usage is down to zero.

Avery Solar and Electrical was no doubt the best decision we made when we chose an installer for our solar.Great communication from start to finish, the installers were on time and extremely professional, they did an outstanding job and took away the old panels and all the rubbish.I could not be happier, they were outstanding.
Complete process was a great experienceAll of the above Polite, Tidy, PunctualCustomer service was excellent and yes
Rhys (sales) was very helpful with picking the system size. The team arrived on the day on time and were very efficient, leaving the worksite clean and everything working well.
Avery we're very professional and prompt. They turned up when they said they would, explaining the systems to me and not trying to oversell to me.
Everything about the install was smooth from the quote to the completed install. They worked with me to create what I wanted and left everything tidy and are helping with the grid connection. A++
Sales/ quoting was responsive to my needs. The installation was punctual, tidy and the guys were very polite. The service afterwards was as promised and all was functioning straight away.

Very professional and personal service from the get go! Chris Avery was generous with his time and explained all our options. The quoting process was quick and clear and the installers were very efficient. We are pleased with our choice!
Avery quoted local quickly and rep turned up and discussed then quoted. 2nd quoter a day later but from Brisbane with installer from Seven Hills. 3rd quoter a week later, after decision made

From start to finish Avery were exceptional, including: attention to detail; a large amount of general and timely communication to appease my own research needs and to assist with my selection of the final products; Chris (the owner) was on-site for the installation and is one of the most meticulous installers I've ever had the privilege to do business with. There is no other installer in the Blue Mountains that I would recommend over Avery. I'm a very happy customer.

It is difficult to rate anything properly other than the installation at this stage because we are technically unable to comment on value or quality and as it was only installed yesterday there has been no requirement for customer service other than the quoting and preparation for the installation, which was very good.All three quotes were in a similar price range and two were similar in system arrangement. All offers included a revision of the original quote to include our requests and noted the limitations of our local network on what was the maximum size that was cost effective for our area. All had a good guarantee period.Quoted costs were probably 50 to 70% higher than those generic advertisements seen on Facebook for a similar sized system but we have Australian designed panels with recommended micro-inverters for each panel rather than a single inverter system, as well as a wifi connection/app system to see how the individual panels are performing and how much we are consuming, producing and exporting. We also had a reliable local provider with a good warranty.The installation was punctual, tidy and completed in the advised time. An adjustment was made to the panel layout to suit the site and sun angle better and minimise shadowing - this was advised by the installer and agreed. The installation had the panels with a good space underneath to allow ventilation for better performance on hot days.The installer has made contact with the energy supplier to advise of the change and we await the supplier to replace the meter. We will then review our supplierThe installer warranty is 7 years.

Made a appointment for site inspection and go over the quote, arrived on time. Installation went without incident, polite, helpful and all round Great. They organised everything in a super efficient manner and explained how to use the app.
Sale to install was seamless. Now awaiting for smart meter to complete job. After exploring the benefits of a battery l am convinced of their need.Street view is very good with only 2 panels in view.

As our system was only installed today i cannot comment further but this supplier installed efficiently and on the day i was quoted i look forwared to dealing with avery solar & electrical for any service of other help required.

Out of the 5 yes 5 quotes Avery Solar where the only ones to actually take the time to come out and see the house and orientation. Rhys is not the pushy salesmen working on commission type and provided tiered options for the type of system I was looking for and budget I had. The battery was my addition and not his even though we went through the different scenarios of ROI on battery systems he left the decision to me. I work with a lot of electrical engineers so I have a great source to draw upon and that did help. I think it made Rhys and Chris and the other quoting installers lives fun for a few weeks there with the questions I kept asking but in the end I made the call and am very glad I went with the Avery Solar team.Chris, Jarrod, Jake, Harry, Lucius and Ben do first class work in the Blue Mountains and surrounds. They were on time, thorough, always helpful and courteous. They wanted to know where we wanted things to go in regards to the battery and car charger etc and suggested ideas that may be better (and they were right mostly). They cleaned up after all was said and done and you would not know they had installed such a large array of panels from the road, except for the battery and charger under the carport.They organised grid connection and have made solar such a great experience for a solar first timer. These guys are first rate at their job and if I need an electrician in the future I will be calling Chris or someone from his team first.If you are looking for solar or electrical in the Blue Mountains give Rhys and Chris a call. First rate company. We are very happy with our system.

Avery contacted me by phone but politely insisted they did a face to face site visit. During this time they reviewed the different options available and said there was no need for micro inverters as suggested by others as we have zero shadow issues. They provided 3 different quotes for the suggested configurations but recommend we go for the cheaper one. (Same good quality panels but using a multi string inverter.)The installation was done on time, very neat and tidy job and they then arranged for the meter change.Very happy.

The sales rep took time to explain all the details. We negotiated a slight price reduction.Installation went smoothly and workers were polite and respectful of our property. The company boss was present for the installation and kept things going smoothly. They put tilt brackets on our roof to increase our solar production.The company set up the grid and app for keeping track of our usage.
The end to end process was very easy and everyone was nice and pleasant and very helpful

A very swift response to initial enquire.  Great explanation of the solar system we chose.  Installation was carried out as soon as it was possible.  Contact was excellent when there was a short unavoidable delay.  Thorough explanation of how the system works after installation.  The installer was excellent.

Avery solar where fabulous throughout the entire process. All staff we dealt with were extremely friendly, helpful and informative.  They answered all questions we had, regardless of the time of day, and nothing was a drama. They kept us informed of every step along the way. They arranged everything including the grid connection after the install. We would not hesitate to recommend Avery Solar to anyone local who is looking to install solar!

Although the grid connection is stalled due to my supplier who claims a backlog, the quoting, and installation were thorough, punctual, polite ant tidy. I cannot fault Avery and would recommend them to anyone; in fact I already have.

Avery’s sales and quoting process was a pleasant experience Rhys made contact quickly and organized a time to visit our home. On the day he arrived on time and explained the ins and outs of the system they were offering and went through the technical detail, he inspected the proposed positions for the equipment whilst engaging thoughts from both myself and my wife. The quote was received the next day with a follow up to confirm receipt and if we had any questions.On the day of the installation Avery’s team arrived on time and individually introduced themselves and outlined what they would be doing, quickly they commenced work in a professional and safe manner, they were very tolerant to my questions and managed to explain what was going on while still diligently progressing the work. Soon Chris Avery arrived to check and help with the installation he took the time to check the work that was being done personally and then introduced himself and explained what would be happening.The team were always polite diligent in cleaning up and ensuring they didn’t damage anything. The installation looks great and seems to work as advertised, Chris had organised the grid connection and replacement of the meters he also has followed up to ensure everything is working and has been monitoring remotely to ensure it is working correctly, so thumbs up for customer Service. In summary great installation and great company.
The whole process from start to finish with Avery was excellent - we really, really recommend them!
Quotes were all pretty good, but Avery went the extra distance. I also like to support the local guys who are helpful.
On time kept me informed great service friendly explained the process

Chris was punctual and easy to work with in the quoting process.  My questions and concerns were always addressed reasonably and fairly.  The installers were tidy and did a great job with the install.  I did have to organize my own meter swap, though Chris provided all the required details to do this through my electricity retailer, and the process was painless.  After the install some support questions about the inverter management did take a while to get answers, but the support was still provided.

I was pleasantly surprised to find Chris could provide a better price than a couple of bigger companies. He didn't try to oversell and was flexible enough to use panels I requested rather than forcing a particular brand on me. Pleasant to deal with. On time and did everything he said he would. I recommend Avery.

We went with Avery as they are more local and we liked the price. The service was good and they are friendly and polite. Some delay for parts but they kept us informed. Panels were installed in October and a diverter for our water heater was installed today. We will be back to them for a battery in the future.
Chris and the team provided top shelf service, advice and installation from start to finish. Would happily recommend.

The installation was booked in quickly. The team did the installation very quickly. The owner came to check on the install mid way through and then at the end to make sure it was all good. I've had some questions since the installation has been done and the team have been very helpful with their prompt responses.

Requested quotes from Solarquotes and within days was contacted by three suppliers. All good quotes but eventually went with Avery Solar & Electrical. Excellent communication and installation was done quickly and on time. They even organised grid connection and smart meter.Would definitely recommend Avery Solar and Solarquotes.

Chris was punctual and had a great team. Super helpful with info and follow up post panel installation. Chris called me a couple of times for more info regarding the house and our needs prior to providing the quote. Highly recommended ??
Efficient and polite. A real Pleasure to deal with. Looks good and works well. Very clean.
The process of quoting, installation and communication was seamless. An excellent company and team. Highly recommended.
The Avery team were very efficient and friendly. Recommended for installation and service.
Quote was thorough and specific to my needs.  The installation was delayed by adverse weather and the installers worked cheerfully in cold and windy conditions to get the job done.

The process from first contact to installation was efficient and seamless.Chris responded to our inquiry and answered questions in timely and efficient way.The installation was only delayed by weather. The installers were competent, careful and respectful.

Chris was the only one of the 3 who came and visited my location. He made the time to have long conversations about what would be the right system for my needs and he has a no pressure sales style.His crew were punctual and friendly and the installation process was efficient and effective.

Chris of Avery Solar has been a pleasure to do business with. In fact his whole team have been great. Chris did a comprehensive inspection of our roof, unlike the others from whom we obtained quotes, and provided clear advice based on our current electricty use. He answered all our questions and explained our options.The installation was well organised and efficiently done.  Excellent customer service.

I ended up getting 6 quotes in total and did 3 weeks of research.Spent countless time on the phone with several solar providers who where all very polite.Answered all my questions, changed my mind a thousand times and in the end I went with Chris from Avery solar.The product Avery Solar suggested was in my opinion the best system. It was in the top tier in quality and performance.It was also priced right. Other quotes came in cheaper and more expensive for similar products.In the end Avery’s good online reviews, the product he recommended and his fair pricing was what put him in my top three, in the end I had a good gut feeling on Avery and I went with them.From memory I think it was 2 weeks from contract signed to install day.Chris came out to inspect the property next day I accepted to make sure everything was as it looked.His team where polite and mission focused. I Was home during the two days of install. He installed 26 sun power panels with a Tesla battery.Very respectful and positive experience.The work was neat and tidy and functions as intended.Recommend Avery Solar for any solar solutions and any electrical needs.
Got clear information, a range of options and provided a solution i was really happy with. Installation, despite the delays and difficulties caused by Covid went very smoothly. Highly recommended.
Very happy with Chris and his team's work with the solar. From the start Chris was very helpful with answering my questions and wasn't pushy like I experienced with other companies
Everything about the sales/quoting process was smooth and simple. The installation was great, the team were punctual, happy to answer any questions and left the site tidy and as they had found it.

Avery have been a pleasure to deal with all the way through. From quotation to installation Chris and his team have been knowable, polite, professional and took pride and care in their work (and my house). The high level of personal customer service was always about me as a person; not a sale. I love it new solar system and can’t recommend Avery Electrical enough.
Very happy with the whole process. Very speedy from quote to installation
Very happy with the whole experience. The system seems good so far and I can't fault the customer service.

Sales/quoting was quick & efficient, very informative.Installation was polite, tidy & punctual smooth running & under a full day.We've had contact regarding grid connection. Paperwork has been submitted.
battery_brand: No Battery yet, want to get one but don't know about reliability & performance (Other)

review_description: Cannot speak too highly of Chris and his team throughout the whole process. 100% recommendation

Chris came to inspect the site prior to quoting.  He was very knowledgeable, approachable and showed a genuine interest in wanting to help us get the best system for our home - Not a pushy sales experience at all! The fact that he is the installer meant that there were no installation ‘surprises’!  Indeed a dedicated and very conscientious team of individuals turned up (including Chris who was on the roof with his team) and the installation was completed professionally and on time.  They cleaned up afterwards and even replaced the tiles that they found had cracked.  Highly recommended!

Chris and his team were great. After several quotes it was nice that the installer quoted the job. He was very knowledgeable. Also every quote was different making my decision hard. Chris quoted the same panels as my next best quote so I could have a comparison. So happy.

Information provided in quote was comprehensive and useful - only supplier who came to site before quoting. Immediate response with install date after signing of contract. Organisation of install was excellent and installers efficient and personable. At time of install modification to placement of panels was necessary - this was discussed in detail and, at this point, monitoring of the system has shown that the changes seem not to have affected output from the system. Connection to our electricity provider was completed a few days after install.

Chris Avery from Avery Electrical Solutions arroved on time for the review of the property for the quote. He listened to what I was planning, made a few sensible suggestions that improved the system.Chris' information was excellent and very clear.Installation, clean up and finished product could not be faulted.I would use Avery Electrical Solutions for any future work without hesitation.

Chris was very knowledgeable about the different products he installs and happy to explain the benefits of each for comparison even including his home as an example of how the monitoring system works.On the day of installation it was very warm but the guys installing kept working through the heat and after a full day my new system was up and running.I would certainly recommend Avery Electrical Solutions for solar installations with no hesitation.

I am so impressed with the team at avery electrical solutions from start to finish chris made this experience so smooth.His team were so tidy and efficient.I was very impressed with the quote I received and I am so happy with my new system!I would highly recommend chris and the boys at Avery ELectrical Solutions to anyone.I am now a proud owner of a wonderful sleek solar system.
The installation was smooth and on time.  I was given the detail to get the grid connection done.

Was very good dealing with company and organising installation. On day of installation they advised they would send details to monitor solar panels. I have needed to chase this up a few times with them. After having the panels installed for 2 weeks received an email saying I needed to call my electricity provider and have meter changed. My understanding was that they were organising that.
Avery were quick to respond always, excellent advise and quote.  Service was faultless, wish other experiences were as pleasant.  Would definitely recommend Chris from Avery anytime.

Avery Electrical provided a prompt visit and quote and then a revised one when we had thought more about best options. Installation went very smoothly - polite, tidy and punctual. The customer service was really good - informative and friendly - and  responsive to queries. Avery also helped organise the grid connection for us, which is booked for next week.

The sales/quoting process was very professional.The installation went a bit slow but pretty smooth and uneventful.Everything from quoting, grid approval, installation and configuring the app was handled very professionally.Would highly recommend Avery Electrical Solutions to everyone.

Chris contacted me promptly after requesting a quote. He came the next day and spent the time to explain the options for a solar system (panels, inverter type, panel orientation etc) considering our roof layout, trees and shading. We received an email quote that evening. Installation was completed on the agreed day. Chris and his team did a great job. Very professional installation, and they cleaned up after!  Great to have a local installer who can be contacted. I would highly recommend them.

- Clear quote and ready to talk you through the options- Arrived on time and got stuck into the work immediately- Kept me informed of any issues and gave me all the options- Work completed within the timeframe and left the area clean- Would highly recommend Avery Electrical to anyone.

Chris at Avery Electrical was a pleasure to deal with. I was happy with the quote provided and went ahead him. Unlike some other installers he actually knew what he was talking about and tailored a solution to my house rather then trying to sell me a cheap inefficient unit to improve his profit margin. I found that he really understood the products and installation. Process.The installation went well and he has provided responsive after sales service. Highly recommend.
Very efficient through  the whole process from quote to after sales service.  Helped guide us through the entire process.  Highly recommended.
